verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a broad programmatic surface. That includes a REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a per-endpoint reference covering agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and an MCP server with 117 tools. Together these cover the core run, agent, session and credential operations that the dashboard also exposes. However, nothing states UI/API parity, and several UI-centric features have no documented API equivalent: the Copilot agent builder, the browser recorder, SOP upload, Studio editing, scheduling and template sharing. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage for Copilot/recorder/SOP-based workflow creation, scheduling and sharing, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
